coordinator_action: Review and freeze target shapes before any active serializer or grammar change. This file does not authorize admission or alter shared grammar.
global_constraints: No standalone admission for an internal checkpoint
All recursive targets require common F1 header, family owner, serializer, E1-E4, and T5 ticket
Higher p-adic congruence is evidence only until EMPTY/TERMINAL/PAID is proved
No new mark is proposed by this track

Whether t2_v1_atomic_pending_target can represent the genuine two-sided payload without changing semantics
Owner precedence between atomic pending, high-support sink, and low-support overflow
Mandatory normalize_target_state and pending_dispatch contract for all R2 targets
Whether source path artifacts are stored as evidence only or attached to a future producer receipt
